# CleanBrowsing

> CleanBrowsing is a DNS-based content filtering service that protects families, schools, libraries, businesses, and organizations from harmful and unwanted online content. It works at the network level by filtering DNS requests — no software installation required. Founded by Daniel Cid and Tony Perez, CleanBrowsing processes over 355 billion DNS requests per month across 70+ global data centers serving 4.5+ million devices.

## Overview

CleanBrowsing provides cloud-based DNS filtering that blocks access to unwanted websites through DNS resolution. It offers both free public DNS resolvers and paid plans with granular controls. The service supports encrypted DNS (DoH, DoT, DNSCrypt) and uses an anycast network architecture for performance and reliability.

### Free DNS Resolvers

- **Family Filter:** `185.228.168.168` / `185.228.169.168` — Blocks adult content, enforces SafeSearch, blocks VPNs and proxies
- **Adult Filter:** `185.228.168.10` / `185.228.169.11` — Blocks adult content and malware
- **Security Filter:** `185.228.168.9` / `185.228.169.9` — Blocks malware, phishing, and botnets only

### Paid Plans

- **Basic ($8.99/mo):** Up to 25 devices, 3 profiles, 26+ filtering categories
- **Pro 50 ($15/mo):** Up to 50 devices, 5 profiles, ideal for schools and libraries
- **Pro 100 ($30/mo):** Up to 100 devices, 10 profiles, API access, for organizations
- **Custom:** 100+ devices, dedicated IPs, custom networks — contact sales

## Key Pages

- [Chrome & Edge macOS DNS Profiles](https://cleanbrowsing.org/support/troubleshooting/chrome-edge-macos-profiles): Fix Chrome and Edge ignoring macOS DNS profiles (.mobileconfig)
- [Purchase Order (PO) Payment Process](https://cleanbrowsing.org/support/troubleshooting/purchase-order-process): How to pay via purchase order — PO workflow, $150 admin fee, Net-30 terms, multi-year options
- [Firewall & DNS Requirements](https://cleanbrowsing.org/support/troubleshooting/firewall-dns-requirements): Network and firewall requirements for CleanBrowsing DNS — required IPs, ports (53, 853, 443), firewall allowlisting, ISP DNS interception, DNS forwarder troubleshooting, and encrypted DNS (DoH/DoT)
- [Getting Started](https://cleanbrowsing.org/getting-started): Quick-start guide for new users

## Contact

- **Partners:** partners@cleanbrowsing.org

Used by 5+ million devices worldwide

Protect Every Network with Affordable DNS Filtering.

From schools and businesses to public Wi-Fi networks, CleanBrowsing delivers reliable, family-safe browsing for any environment.

View Plans & Pricing Secure Your Network

Trusted by 10,000+ Families, Schools & Businesses

Why CleanBrowsing

Why Teams and Families Trust CleanBrowsing

Simple to deploy. Powerful in protection. CleanBrowsing combines enterprise-grade security with family-safe filtering — no contracts, just results.

DNS Security

CleanBrowsing’s DNS Filter builds a secure layer between your network and online threats — acting like a firewall for malicious activity.

Protect your users against:
  • Web-based malware
  • Command & Control (C&C) attacks
  • Phishing attempts
  • Botnets
Learn more about DNS Security

Block Online Porn

CleanBrowsing automatically blocks explicit and adult content, helping families, schools, and organizations maintain a cleaner digital space.

It helps stop online porn by:
  • Blocking known adult sites (e.g., pornhub)
  • Blocking obscene sites (e.g., fetishes)
  • Moderating videos and images
  • Enforcing Safe Search where available
Learn more about Block Online Porn

Content Filtering

Empower your organization to define what content is acceptable. CleanBrowsing lets you easily filter unwanted or distracting websites.

With CleanBrowsing, you can:
  • Block malicious or non-work-related sites
  • Manage access to social networks
  • Improve productivity and focus
  • Align filtering with company policy
Learn more about Content Filtering

SafeSearch Enforcement

CleanBrowsing enforces SafeSearch on Google, Bing, and YouTube—filtering explicit results automatically across your network.

It enhances SafeSearch by:
  • Enforcing strict SafeSearch on Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo
  • Locking YouTube to Moderate or Restricted Mode
  • Disabling Google’s “Blur” mode to ensure stronger filtering
  • Applying protections at the DNS layer — no browser configuration needed
Learn more about SafeSearch Enforcement

Technical Advantages

The CleanBrowsing DNS Filter platform is a global network designed to ensure reliability and optimal performance (i.e., low latency).

CleanBrowsing offers:
  • Anycast network configuration
  • Multiple profiles with unique DNS IPv4 pairs (option for static)
  • 20 predefined platforms
  • Support for encrypted DNS technologies (DOH, DOT, DNSCrypt)
  • 21 predefined filtering categories
  • Easily block and allow domains
Benefits

What You Get with CleanBrowsing

Everything you need for safe, reliable, and simple internet protection.

Advanced Encryption

Protect your network with encrypted DNS protocols — DoH, DoT, and DNSCrypt — all enabled by default for safer browsing.

Predefined Filters

Instantly apply 19+ ready-made filters to block adult, mixed, or harmful content with just a few clicks.

Custom Allow / Block

Easily manage access by creating personalized “Allow” or “Block” lists for your network domains.

Profiles

Group devices and assign custom filtering rules based on each group’s needs (e.g., Teachers vs Students).

Data Retention

Control how long logs are stored — from privacy-first “no logs” mode to detailed 90-day records.

Activity Monitoring

Track browsing activity through a simple, modern dashboard with real-time usage insights.

How it works

Get Protected in Just Three Simple Steps

Simplicity is our strength. Whether you’re protecting your family, school, or business—CleanBrowsing helps you secure every device in minutes.

STEP 1

Choose Your Plan

Pick the plan that fits your needs — from families to large organizations.

STEP 2

Update Your DNS

Connect CleanBrowsing to your router or device with a quick setup.

STEP 3

You're Protected!

Browse safely. Filtering and privacy protection work automatically.

Safer Internet. Smarter Control.

Instantly block harmful content and create safe, reliable online spaces.
